mapper.insert: insert into bargain (item_id, buyer_id, offer_price, message, status) values (#{itemId}, #{buyerId}, #{offerPrice}, #{message}, 'PENDING')
mapper.select: select b.*, i.title as itemTitle, i.price as itemPrice, i.seller_id as sellerId, u.nickname as buyerNickname from bargain b left join item i on b.item_id = i.id left join `user` u on b.buyer_id = u.id where b.id = #{id}
mapper.update: update bargain set status = #{status}, handled_at = now() where id = #{id}
update bargain set status = 'REJECTED', handled_at = now() where item_id = #{itemId} and id != #{exceptId} and status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: select buyer_id from bargain where item_id = #{itemId} and status = 'ACCEPTED' order by id desc limit 1
select id from bargain where item_id = #{itemId} and buyer_id = #{buyerId} and status = 'PENDING' limit 1
